articles.title: Commit Biologics announces final close of $60 million seed financing to advance complement-powered immune engagers toward the clinic
articles.description: The final close was led by Ackermans & van Haaren, with participation from additional new investors AbbVie Ventures and M Ventures, alongside existing investors Bioqube Ventures, Korys and Novo HoldingsFunds will take first development candidate COM002 into the clinic, advance a second program into IND-enabling development and expand the BiCE™ pipelineMichael Rosenzweig (AbbVie Ventures), Charlotte Kremers (M Ventures) and Lenny Van Steenhuyse (Ackermans & van Haaren) join the Board of DirectorsCOPENHAGEN, Denmark, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Commit Biologics ('Commit”), the biotechnology company pioneering complement-powered immune engagers, today announced the completion of a $60 million (€54 million) seed financing round to advance its pipeline of complement-powered immune engagers toward the clinic. The final close was led by Ackermans & van Haaren, with participation from additional new investors AbbVie Ventures and M Ventures, and existing investors Bioqube Ventures, Korys and Novo Holdings.
